    """Duplicate each outer row and column once, leaving interior lines single."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_indices = [0] + list(range(1, h - 1)) + [h - 1]
    col_indices = [0] + list(range(1, w - 1)) + [w - 1]
    row_indices = [i for idx in row_indices for i in ((idx, idx) if idx in (0, h - 1) else (idx,))]
    col_indices = [i for idx in col_indices for i in ((idx, idx) if idx in (0, w - 1) else (idx,))]
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in col_indices] for r in row_indices]
